name: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp.
summary: RRE Ventures Acquisition Corp. functions as a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). Its core mission involves executing a business combination – which could encompass a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or reorganization – with one or more target entities. The firm was established on February 28, 2026, and its main offices are located in Boca Raton, Florida.
